item.title: Holy Moly: Affordable Housing Proposed for Catholic Center
item.description: A Brooklyn-based affordable housing developer is seeking to expand its Buffalo footprint. BFC Partners has offered to purchase the Diocese of Buffalo’s Catholic Center complex located at the northeast corner of Main and Goodell streets. The purchase offer of $4.5 million, substantially less than the $9.8 million sought by the diocese, is subject to approval by the U.S. Bankruptcy Court which is overseeing the diocese’s Chapter 11 case. item.title: Transitioning to a Circular Economy Starts with Dare to Repair Cafés
item.description: In the US, approximately 146 million tons of municipal solid waste are sent to landfills annually, which is incomprehensible. Globally, more than 2 billion tons of municipal solid waste are generated yearly. To make matters worse, waste generation is expected to increase by 70% or more by 2050, potentially reaching over 3.78 billion metric tons annually.
